dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deep concave spline along the trailing edge, originating from a rounded apex and extending toward the peduncle with increasing curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; lacks sharp points or extreme blunting.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin rising at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-to-width ratio is approximately 1.2:1 based on visible base line and vertical apex extension.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct notches along the trailing edge, including a small indentation near the apex and a larger, V-shaped notch mid-way down. Superficial linear scratches/rake marks are visible on the mid-lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Mottled pigmentation pattern visible on the lower section of the dorsal fin near the anterior base.
